display_name: Art History - museum plate line drawings (limited AI inserts)
locked_model: klein (config/image_engine.json -> model); prompt target klein, variant C

media_policy.note: AI plates may cover at most 15% of the runtime. An AI plate must never imitate or reproduce a specific real artwork: it may show a generic motif study or a diagram of composition. Real artworks come from CC0 / public-domain museum records with their own rights records.

line_style.name: museum plate line drawing
line_style.prompt_phrase: museum plate line drawing, fine ink contours, hatching, two muted accent washes
rules: contour line first, hatching for volume
no photographic texture, no impasto simulation

light: even neutral illumination, no photographic depth

camera_vocabulary.front: flat front view of the motif, centered, catalogue-plate margins
camera_vocabulary.side: profile view of the motif, centered, catalogue-plate margins
camera_vocabulary.three_quarter: three-quarter view of the motif, near and far planes readable
camera_vocabulary.detail_crop: close crop on one detail of the motif
camera_vocabulary.wide_context: wide plate of the motif in a generic setting, small in frame

constraints.positive: clean image without text, text-free, no letters, no numerals, no watermark, no signature
constraints.negative: text, watermark, letters, numerals, signature, inscription

constraints.positive: drawn line work, not a photograph, not a photorealistic painting
constraints.negative: photorealism, photograph, oil painting texture, photorealistic

constraints.positive: no human figures, no faces, no portrait likeness
constraints.negative: people, person, portrait, face, likeness, figure

constraints.positive: no emblems, no insignia, no flags, no logos, no watermarks
constraints.negative: emblem, insignia, flag, logo, watermark, signature

constraints.positive: generic original motif study, an invented subject
constraints.negative: copy of a known painting, famous artwork, reproduction of a specific artwork

constraints.positive: wide plain margins around the motif
constraints.negative: full bleed, cropped edges, busy frame

label_rule.label: Illustration
label_rule.gate: every AI cut carries the label; the AI share stays within the niche limit (max 15% of runtime); an AI plate is never presented as a real artwork

anatomy_rule.rule: no creatures in this niche; the motif and its parts are named in the prompt

seed_policy.rule: one fixed seed per plate and view, recorded in the manifest; never reuse a seed for two subjects inside one batch

editorial_overlays_rule: labels, callouts, arrows, measurement lines and numbers are drawn in the editor, never by the image model
